analysis.hypothesis: The needed CUDA file only needs to define the mul_bias_forward launcher; the convolution operator will be implemented in a separate C++ binding file using cuDNN. The mul_bias kernel must broadcast a per-channel bias across batch and length dimensions.
evidence: The task states that Conv/ConvTranspose must use cuDNN and that .cpp binding files are responsible for Tensor handling. The current stage only permits generating kernels/custom_ops.cu.
The custom_ops_contract.json defines the operator signatures and shapes; mul_bias_forward operates on tensors of shape [batch_size, out_channels, length_out] and bias [out_channels, 1].
No existing kernel files are present, so custom_ops.cu must be created.
changes: Create kernels/custom_ops.cu with a simple broadcast multiplication kernel and launcher.
The kernel indexes threads along the flattened output and reconstructs (n, c, l) to access bias[c].
The launcher will be declared extern "C" so that a future binding.cpp can call it.
No torch/ATen/c10/pybind includes are used; only cuda_runtime.h.
Code compiles as a standalone CUDA file.
